name: Twitch Chat Plinko
description: Type !drop in chat, or any command you choose yourself, and a chip with your name on it drops through a Plinko board on stream. Every drop plays in the order chat sent it, one chip per chatter at a time, bouncing off every peg into a slot worth 5 in the middle and 1000 at the rare edges. Read straight from Twitch chat with nothing to connect and no bot to add.
changelog: Initial release. The sixth product, and the first with its own physics: a board the overlay draws, fed by chat.
hero_alt: Twitch Chat Plinko on stream: chips carrying chatters' names bounce down a Plinko board into slots worth 5 to 1000 points
obs_hint: Make the browser source your whole canvas, 1920 by 1080. It is a full scene, made for BRB and downtime.
ready_message: Every !drop in your chat drops a chip. Type it in your own chat to see the first one land.
highlights: Chat types !drop, or any word you pick, and a chip with their name on it bounces down a Plinko board on your stream.
Played in the order chat sends it, one chip each. A big chat waits in a line you can see.
Nothing to connect and no bot to add. Top scores fill in as the chips land.

pitch.meta_title: Twitch Chat Plinko - a Plinko game your chat plays
pitch.meta_description: Twitch Chat Plinko puts Plinko on your stream as an OBS browser source. Chat types !drop and their name bounces down the board. Free, no bot, no points.
pitch.tagline: Introducing Plinko for Twitch Chat: The perfect game for downtime.
pitch.lede: Twitch Chat Plinko is a game where a chip drops from the top of the pyramid and random luck decides the score. Your Twitch Chat controls it: every `!drop` (or the word you pick) sends a chip with that chatter's name on it down the board. Scores are kept and appear on screen.

pitch.reasons_heading: Twitch Chat Plinko: the Plinko you know, played by your chat.

reasons.title: Played in chat order
reasons.body: Every drop takes its turn in the order chat sent it. When chat is busy, everyone waits in a line that shows on screen.

reasons.title: Twitch Chat Plinko keeps score
reasons.body: The six latest drops and the five best totals fill in beside the board as the chips land.

reasons.title: Nothing to set up
reasons.body: No bot and no account to connect. Twitch Chat Plinko reads your chat directly, like any viewer does.

reasons.title: Follows your mods
reasons.body: When a mod deletes a drop or times someone out, their chip leaves the board. Chatters you have hidden never get one.

pitch.looks_lede: Pick one in the designer, then change any of the five colors, from the pegs to the highlight, to match your stream.
pitch.setup_note: Size the browser source to your whole canvas, 1920 by 1080. Twitch Chat Plinko is a full scene, made for BRB and downtime.

faq.a: `!drop`, unless you picked another word. Anything after it still counts, so `!drop come on edges` drops a chip too.

faq.q: What if my whole chat drops at once?
faq.a: Everyone gets a turn. Up to 150 chips are on the board at once and ten new ones join every second. Everyone else waits in line in the order they typed, and the line shows on screen.

faq.q: Can one chatter flood the board?
faq.a: No. Each chatter has one chip at a time. Another drop while theirs is still on the board is ignored.
They count from when the overlay loaded. Reloading the browser source starts a new game.

faq.q: My channel already uses !drop. Can I change it?
faq.a: Yes. Pick any word on the Plinko page in your settings, under Integrations, and the board listens for that instead.

faq.q: Does it need the Overlabels bot?
faq.a: No. Twitch Chat Plinko reads your chat directly. The bot never has to be in your channel.

pitch.closing: Let your chat drop the first chip tonight.

notes: Hiding commands in the chat feed does not stop Plinko, since that setting only hides them from the feed. Chatters on your hidden list never get a chip.
Scores count from when the overlay loaded. Reloading the browser source starts a new game.
The command is !drop unless you pick another word on the Plinko page (Settings, Integrations). Reload the browser source in OBS after changing it.
